== Active Skill: Kannonbiraki Benihime Aratame ==
Kisuke will buff his allies’ range by 20% and SPA by 10%. This ability is stackable with other buffs (except [[Priest (Heaven)]]'s Time Acceleration, but range buffs still stack), his ability cooldown is not global and is very useful for pretty much every mode making Kisuke very worth getting.

==Selling==
Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.

==Trivia==
* His upgrades' costs were just the same as [[Paradox (Divine Sight)]].
